title: Modelling suicide ideation from beep to beep: Application of network analysis to ecological momentary assessment data
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample only consists of patients with Major Depression; - Limited EMA design (10 beeps per day) might have missed important events; - Important risk factors like defeat and entrapment were not included; - Self-report data only; - Underpowered to detect subtle dynamic relations.
notes: The paper was preregistered on OSF (https://osf.io/ydjpa/). Code and data are declared available. The study used a sample of psychiatric inpatients, which may limit ecological validity.
